About.about_quote: “The customs, values, and behaviors that are accepted by a particular group, culture, and community”
About.about_quote_2: Creative thinking is where the problem-solving began. Combined with a strong understanding of the real situation, reliable data, and viable methods, we can introduce a new strategy without disrupting the existing process.
About.about_desc_1: Mores Strategics adalah konsultan strategis yang mengkhususkan diri dalam analisis data, teknologi, dan penelitian etnografi. Kami bekerja dengan pendekatan yang disesuaikan dengan membangun kemitraan strategis yang kuat dan mengadaptasi kerangka kerja kami agar sesuai dengan kebutuhan, tujuan, dan kapasitas klien kami. Kami mencari strategi kreatif yang didasarkan pada analitik dan kebiasaan di masyarakat.
About.about_desc_2: Kami percaya bahwa adat istiadat lokal adalah aspek fundamental dalam pengembangan strategi. Nasihat strategis kami bertujuan untuk memberikan dampak positif yang berkelanjutan bagi pemangku kepentingan dan komunitas, serta menjaga hubungan baik antara semua pihak yang terlibat. Oleh karena itu, memahami perspektif dan perilaku masyarakat lokal adalah hal yang utama dalam operasi kami.

IndustryPage.title: INDUSTRIES
IndustryPage.description_header: OUR STRATEGY IS TAILORED FOR SPECIFIC INDUSTRY WITH MULTI APPROACH BASIS.
IndustryPage.description_content:
By profiling the clients first, identifying their industry and their targeted market, we are able to conduct multiple research approaches to reach the best possible strategy and solution for our client goals.

This involves understanding their unique characteristics, the specific industry they operate in, and the market they aim to target. By gaining a deep understanding of these factors, we can tailor our research approaches to align with their specific needs. We then employ various research methodologies to gather comprehensive insights and data. This multi-faceted research enables us to develop a strategic plan that is finely tuned to the client’s objectives, ensuring that we provide the most effective solutions to help them achieve their goals.
